headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, TT&A, Khaitan & Co act on Hygenco $105 million fundraise
sum: Hygenco Green Energies Private Limited has raised $105 million from a fundraise led by International Finance Corporation, Siemens Financial Services and Fullerton Asset Management.
detail: Hygenco Green Energies Private Limited has raised $105 million from a fundraise led by International Finance Corporation, Siemens Financial Services and Fullerton Asset Management. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Hygenco and its promoters on this fundraise. The transaction team was led by Amarta Roy (Partner) and Ishita Khandelwal (Partner), with support from Shreya Teewari (Principal Associate), Parnika Malhotra (Consultant), Bharti Singh (Senior Associate) and Aeruva Akash (Associate). Amarta Roy, Ishita Khandelwal, with CAM logo TT&A advised IFC and Fullerton on their investments in Hygenco.
